steps.text: Daily: only one player per day gets the reward. Bring a rope and an antidote.
steps.source: This quest is a daily respawn. Recommended equipment: Rope.

steps.text: Go down into the Ancient Temple north of Thais, two floors.
steps.source: Go to the Ancient Temple, north of Thais (Mapper Coords 126.100, 125.171, 7).

steps.text: Go north to the end of the big room and down two floors to the rotworms.
steps.source: Down 2 levels and head North - all the way to the northern end of the large room. Go down to the Rotworms.

steps.text: Follow the long way east, south and east and go down (rotworms, poison spiders, orcs and orc spearmen).
steps.source: Follow this path to the east, south, and east, and go down the ladder. Watch out for Orcs, Orc Spearmen, Orc Warriors.

steps.text: Run through the poison fields (antidote or destroy field) and go down again.
steps.source: This room will be filled with Poison Fields. Once through the poison fields, go down the ladder.

steps.text: Go north past the minotaurs (the room with skeletons is the Ghoul Room Quest) to the sign "Home of the dead Kingdom of Kormarak" and up the stairs (ghouls).
steps.source: Down this ladder there are 3 Minotaurs and a few Poison Spiders. Go north following the line. Go up the stairs and you may have to kill three Ghouls.

steps.text: Kill the 11 ghouls in the room (great fireballs) and the demon skeleton at the far end.
steps.source: Be prepared to face 11 Ghouls spread throughout the room and a Demon Skeleton that spawns at the far end of the room.

steps.text: In the dead human by the wooden coffin: a brass armor, a brass helmet, a hatchet and 13 throwing stars.
steps.source: Open the Dead Human near the Wooden Coffin to find a Brass Armor, a Brass Helmet, a Hatchet and 13 Throwing Stars.
